editorial.summary: Auburn is one of Sydney's most multicultural suburbs, home to large Chinese, Nepalese, Indian and Turkish communities. It sits on the western rail line with connections to Parramatta and the city.
loves: Among the more affordable suburbs this close to Parramatta
Deeply multicultural - large Chinese, Nepalese, Turkish and Indian communities
Auburn Botanic Gardens, and some of Sydney's best cheap eats
thingsToKnow: Fewer nightlife options than the inner city
Busy arterial roads around the town centre
editorial.transportNote: Auburn Station is served by the T1 Western and T2 Leppington and Inner West lines.
